verses.zh: 我儿，不要忘记我的法则；你心要谨守我的诫命；
verses.kjv: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:
verses.en: My son, do not forget what I teach you; let your heart keep my commands,

verses.zh: 因为它必将长久的日子，生命的年数与平安，加给你。
verses.kjv: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.
verses.en: because they will add to your life many days, long years, and peace.

verses.zh: 不可使慈爱、诚实离开你，要系在你颈项上，刻在你心版上。
verses.kjv: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
verses.en: Never let kindness and honesty leave you. Tie them around your neck; write them on your heart.

verses.zh: 这样，你必在神和世人眼前蒙恩宠，有聪明。
verses.kjv: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
verses.en: Then God and people will think well of you, and you will have good sense.

verses.zh: 你要专心仰赖耶和华，不可倚靠自己的聪明，
verses.kjv: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
verses.en: Trust the LORD with your whole heart, and do not lean on how clever you think you are.

verses.zh: 在你一切所行的事上都要认定他，他必指引你的路。
verses.kjv: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
verses.en: Remember him in everything you do, and he will make your paths straight.

verses.zh: 不要自以为有智慧；要敬畏耶和华，远离恶事。
verses.kjv: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil.
verses.en: Do not think you are wise all by yourself. Respect the LORD and stay away from what is wrong.

verses.zh: 这便医治你的肚脐，滋润你的百骨。
verses.kjv: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
verses.en: That will be good health for your body and strength deep in your bones.

verses.zh: 你要以财物和一切初熟的土产尊荣耶和华。
verses.kjv: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
verses.en: Honour the LORD with what you own, and with the first and best of everything you grow.

verses.zh: 这样，你的仓房必充满有余；你的酒榨有新酒盈溢。
verses.kjv: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
verses.en: Then your storerooms will be full, and your barrels will overflow with new wine.

verses.zh: 我儿，你不可轻看耶和华的管教，也不可厌烦他的责备；
verses.kjv: My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD; neither be weary of his correction:
verses.en: My son, do not brush off the LORD's teaching, and do not get tired of being corrected,

verses.zh: 因为耶和华所爱的，他必责备，正如父亲责备所喜爱的儿子。
verses.kjv: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
verses.en: because the LORD corrects the ones he loves, just like a father corrects the son he is proud of.

verses.zh: 得智慧，得聪明的，这人便为有福。
verses.kjv: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.
verses.en: How happy is the person who finds wisdom and gets understanding!

verses.zh: 因为得智慧胜过得银子，其利益强如精金，
verses.kjv: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.
verses.en: Having wisdom is better than having silver, and worth more than pure gold.

verses.zh: 比珍珠宝贵；你一切所喜爱的，都不足与比较。
verses.kjv: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.
verses.en: She is more precious than jewels, and nothing you could wish for compares with her.

verses.zh: 她右手有长寿，左手有富贵。
verses.kjv: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.
verses.en: In her right hand is a long life; in her left hand are riches and honour.

verses.zh: 她的道是安乐；她的路全是平安。
verses.kjv: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
verses.en: Her ways are pleasant ways, and all her paths are peaceful.

verses.zh: 她与持守她的作生命树；持定她的，俱各有福。
verses.kjv: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.
verses.en: She is a tree of life to everyone who holds on to her; whoever keeps her is happy.

verses.zh: 耶和华以智慧立地，以聪明定天，
verses.kjv: The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.
verses.en: By wisdom the LORD made the earth; by understanding he set the sky in place.

verses.zh: 以知识使深渊裂开，使天空滴下甘露。
verses.kjv: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.
verses.en: By what he knows, the deep waters opened up and the clouds drop down dew.

verses.zh: 我儿，要谨守真智慧和谋略，不可使她离开你的眼目。
verses.kjv: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:
verses.en: My son, hold on to real wisdom and good sense; do not let them out of your sight.

verses.zh: 这样，她必作你的生命，颈项的美饰。
verses.kjv: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.
verses.en: They will be life to you, and something beautiful around your neck.

verses.zh: 你就坦然行路，不致碰脚。
verses.kjv: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.
verses.en: Then you will walk your road safely, and your foot will not trip.

verses.zh: 你躺下，必不惧怕；你躺卧，睡得香甜。
verses.kjv: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
verses.en: When you lie down you will not be afraid; you will lie down and sleep sweetly.

verses.zh: 忽然来的惊恐，不要害怕；恶人遭毁灭，也不要恐惧。
verses.kjv: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.
verses.en: Do not be frightened when something scary happens suddenly, or when trouble hits bad people,

verses.zh: 因为耶和华是你所倚靠的；他必保守你的脚不陷入网罗。
verses.kjv: For the LORD shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.
verses.en: because the LORD is the one you trust, and he will keep your foot out of the trap.

verses.zh: 你手若有行善的力量，不可推辞，就当向那应得的人施行。
verses.kjv: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.
verses.en: If you have the power to help someone, do not hold it back from the person who needs it.

verses.zh: 你那里若有现成的，不可对邻舍说：去吧，明天再来，我必给你。
verses.kjv: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.
verses.en: Do not say to your neighbour, "Go away, come back tomorrow and I'll give it" — when you have it right now.

verses.zh: 你的邻舍既在你附近安居，你不可设计害他。
verses.kjv: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.
verses.en: Do not plan to hurt your neighbour, who lives beside you trusting you.

verses.zh: 人未曾加害与你，不可无故与他相争。
verses.kjv: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.
verses.en: Do not pick a fight with someone for no reason, when they have done you no harm.

verses.zh: 不可嫉妒强暴的人，也不可选择他所行的路。
verses.kjv: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.
verses.en: Do not be jealous of a bully, or choose to copy any of his ways,

verses.zh: 因为，乖僻人为耶和华所憎恶；正直人为他所亲密。
verses.kjv: For the froward is abomination to the LORD: but his secret is with the righteous.
verses.en: because the LORD hates a twisted person, but he is close friends with those who do right.

verses.zh: 耶和华咒诅恶人的家庭，赐福与义人的居所。
verses.kjv: The curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.
verses.en: The LORD's curse is on the home of bad people, but he blesses the home of those who do right.

verses.zh: 他讥诮那好讥诮的人，赐恩给谦卑的人。
verses.kjv: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.
verses.en: He laughs at people who sneer, but he is kind to people who are humble.

verses.zh: 智慧人必承受尊荣；愚昧人高升也成为羞辱。
verses.kjv: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.
verses.en: Wise people will be given honour, but fools get shame even when they rise up.
